stages.label: Pre-Bosses
stages.note: Gear up on the surface, build an arena, and gather early ores. First targets: King Slime, the Desert Scourge and Crabulon before you pick an evil boss.

stages.label: Pre-Evil Boss
stages.note: You're ready for your world's evil boss. Beat the Eye of Cthulhu, then the Eater of Worlds / Brain of Cthulhu and Calamity's Hive Mind / Perforators.

stages.label: Post-Evil Boss
stages.note: Evil boss down. Push through Queen Bee and the Slime God, then build a long bridge arena for Skeletron.

stages.label: Pre-Skeletron
stages.note: Beat Skeletron to open the Dungeon, clear the Slime God for Calamity progression, then prep a Hell bridge for the Wall of Flesh.

stages.label: Pre-Wall of Flesh
stages.note: Kill the Wall of Flesh in Hell to enter Hardmode. Bring mobility and a good arena - Hardmode changes everything.

stages.label: Pre-Mechs
stages.note: Hardmode is open. Farm the new ores, fight Cryogen and the Aquatic Scourge, then take on the three Mechanical Bosses.

stages.label: Pre-Plantera
stages.note: Mechs down. Clear Calamity's Brimstone Elemental / Calamitas Clone and Astrum Aureus, then grow and kill Plantera in the Jungle.

stages.label: Pre-Golem
stages.note: Plantera opens the Temple. Beat the Leviathan and Golem, and prepare for the harder Hardmode Calamity bosses.

stages.label: Post-Golem
stages.note: Golem down. Fight the Plaguebringer Goliath and Ravager, then set up an arena for the Lunar Events.

stages.label: Pre-Lunar Events
stages.note: Trigger the Lunar Events (Cultist then Pillars). Beat Astrum Deus along the way and farm the four Pillar fragments.

stages.label: Pre-Moon Lord
stages.note: With fragments in hand, craft your best pre-Moon-Lord gear and kill the Moon Lord to enter Calamity's post-Moon-Lord endgame.

stages.label: Pre-Providence
stages.note: Moon Lord down. Craft post-ML gear and head to the Underworld to fight Providence, the Profaned Goddess.

stages.label: Pre-Polterghast
stages.note: Providence down. Clear the three Sentinels of the Devourer (Ceaseless Void, Storm Weaver, Signus), then face Polterghast in the Abyss.

stages.label: Pre-Devourer of Gods
stages.note: Polterghast down. Beat the Old Duke, then take on the Devourer of Gods.

stages.label: Pre-Yharon
stages.note: DoG down. Craft Cosmilite gear and fight Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth - one of Calamity's hardest fights.

stages.label: Pre-Exo Mechs / Calamitas
stages.note: Yharon down. Only the two final superbosses remain: the Exo Mechs and Supreme Calamitas (either order). Gear up with Yharon's drops.

stages.label: Pre-Supreme Calamitas
stages.note: Going for Supreme Calamitas first - craft post-Yharon / Auric gear and learn her attack patterns before the attempt.

stages.label: Pre-Supreme Calamitas (Exo)
stages.note: Exo Mechs defeated. Use their Exo drops to craft top-tier gear, then take down Supreme Calamitas.

stages.label: Endgame (Post-Supreme Calamitas)

weapons.name: Triactis' True Paladinian Mage-Hammer of Might

stages.note: You've beaten Calamity's final bosses. Craft the endgame sets (Auric / Exo / Draedon), the Ark of the Cosmos and the Zenith, and clear the Boss Rush for the ultimate rewards.
